items.followUp: What is the prefix milli- equal to? Give an example of its use.

rubric.why: Checks the definition and function of prefixes.
rubric.description: Prefixes are placed before units to represent multiples or submultiples of those units.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that prefixes precede units and indicate multiples or submultiples.

rubric.why: Checks a valid prefix example and its value or use.
rubric.description: For example, kilo- means 10^3, so 1 km = 1000 m.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct prefix example with its value or an equivalent unit conversion.

modelAnswer: Prefixes are placed before units to represent multiples or submultiples of those units.
For example, kilo- means 10^3, so 1 km = 1000 m.
